title: Quinlan Vos
subtitle: Sticking the Landing
text: When you play a unit: You may exhaust this leader. If you do, deal 1 damage to an enemy unit that costs the same as the played unit.
deployBox: When you play a unit: You may deal 1 damage to an enemy unit that costs the same as or less than the played unit.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 5 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules: Abilities that refer to a card's cost always refer to its printed cost, regardless of modifiers.
